name: Springsnow Food Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Springsnow Food Group Co., Ltd. is a prominent Chinese enterprise specializing in a vertically integrated poultry supply chain. Its core activities encompass animal feed production, chicken breeding, and chick incubation. The company's primary offerings to consumers include a variety of chicken products, such as frozen split cuts, chilled fresh poultry meat, and value-added cooked chicken items. Its extensive operations further extend to commercial chicken farming, the manufacturing of veterinary pharmaceuticals, and the humane slaughter and processing of poultry. Additionally, Springsnow is involved in the deep processing of prepared food products, alongside research and development and production of food flavors. With a comprehensive domestic and international sales and service network, the company also notably engages in the export of thermal-processed poultry meat and cloven-hoofed animals to the Japanese market. Established in 1992, Springsnow Food Group is headquartered in Laiyang, China.
